items.title: 8.11 Le-Chatelier's principle (Le Chatelier ka usool) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.11, printed page 179.

blocks.text: Le-Chatelier ka principle (usool) yun state (bayan) kiya jata hai:

blocks.title: Le-Chatelier's principle (Le Chatelier ka usool)
blocks.text: Agar equilibrium mein maujood system ko disturb (chheda) kiya jaye to woh is tarah behave karta hai ke us disturbance (chhed-chhaar) ka asar khatam (nullify) ho jaye.
Yeh principle batata hai ke jab koi cheez system ko thori der ke liye equilibrium se hata de to system ke saath kya hota hai.

blocks.title: Henry-Louis Le Chatelier
blocks.text:
(1850-1936)
France ke chemist jo 19th century (sadi) ke aakhir aur 20th century ke shuru mein kaam karte rahe. Unhon ne Le-Chatelier principle pesh kiya, jo chemistry ki ek important achievement (kamyabi) hai.

blocks.prompt: Le-Chatelier ka principle state karein aur batayein ke equilibrium mixture se kuch product nikal dene par kya hoga.
blocks.explanation: Disturb kiya hua equilibrium us disturbance ka asar khatam karne ki taraf shift hota hai. Product nikalne se us ki concentration kam hoti hai, is liye system aur product banata hai: equilibrium products ki taraf (right) shift hota hai, yahan tak ke naya equilibrium ban jaye.
